topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and outlines the key learning objectives regarding cancer therapy approaches.

topics.label: Conventional Cancer Therapies and Their Limitations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional treatment modalities and the problems of non-specific systemic toxicity and acquired drug resistance that limit their clinical effectiveness.

topics.label: Exploiting Intrinsic Cancer Cell Vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe therapeutic approaches designed to exploit intrinsic molecular and genetic vulnerabilities specific to cancer cells.

topics.label: Targeting Oncogenic Drivers with Kinase Inhibitors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on inhibiting hyperactivated oncogenic kinases and examine the molecular mechanisms that lead to drug resistance and addiction.

topics.label: Antibody-Based Targeted Therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe therapeutic strategies that employ antibody-based targeting of tumor cell-surface antigens.

topics.label: Cancer Immunotherapy and T-Cell Activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the interaction between cancer and the immune system, focusing on strategies that harness, redirect, or genetically engineer T cells to destroy tumors.

topics.label: Challenges, Historical Progress, and Future Directions in Cancer Treatment
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics provide an overarching evaluation of clinical progress, ongoing systemic challenges, and future prospects in cancer management.
